title: The Graduated Line
subtitle: A line of diamond that swells so smoothly the eye never sees a step.

stone.origin: A graduated diamond line requires every transition to be invisible — the eye should read a single increase in size and weight from the first stone to the last, not a sequence of visible steps. Each round brilliant was selected so the step from one stone to the next reads as continuation rather than increment. The engineering exists in service of the optical result.

description: A graduated diamond line succeeds only when every transition disappears — the eye should read one continuous increase in size and weight from the first stone to the last, never a sequence of visible steps. Each round brilliant here was selected so the move from one stone to the next reads as growth rather than increment. The engineering is entirely in service of that optical result: a single swelling line of light around the throat, matched and set to fit, in eighteen-karat gold.
